recipe.visualDefinition: A medium portrait of a man in an urban setting, characterized by a desaturated sepia color palette and aggressive white diagonal geometric overlays that frame the subject and host the typography.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject positioned right-of-center looking away from the camera.
Strong diagonal white bands cutting through the left third of the frame.
Text aligned horizontally across a central white geometric cutout.
Muted, warm-toned background contrasting with high-key white graphic elements.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Medium shot of a male figure occupying the right two-thirds of the frame, standing at a slight angle.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and the high-contrast white diagonal lines on the left.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye enters from the bright white lines on the left, follows the horizontal text across the center, and rests on the subject's face looking right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Utilized in the upper right and lower left, though partially filled by architectural details and geometric blocks.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Warm sepia/beige tones in the background and skin tones.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Pure white for the geometric overlays and primary text.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Muted teal/blue for the secondary text.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation overall with high value contrast between the white graphics and the dark clothing of the subject.
paletteRestrictions: Limit to sepia, white, black, and one muted accent color

composition.relationshipToImage: anchored to the left-side graphic elements
continuation of the primary text line

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single font family with weight and color variation for hierarchy.
graphicDevices: Irregular geometric white container for text

candidateDirections.reason: Classic sans-serif with appropriate weight and slant.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a medium portrait of a man in a black t-shirt standing in an urban environment with concrete walls and low-level plants. Apply a desaturated sepia-toned color grade with high contrast. The man should be looking away from the camera toward the right.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add three parallel white diagonal stripes on the left side. Create a white geometric polygon that extends from the stripes toward the center. Place bold, condensed, italicized sans-serif text horizontally inside this polygon, using black for the first part and muted teal for the second.

verificationChecks: Are the diagonal lines sharp and clean?
Is the color palette restricted to sepia, white, and teal?
Is the text condensed and italicized?
Is the subject looking toward the right edge of the frame?

adjustableVariables: Specific teal hue for the accent text
mustRedesign: Artist name and album title wording
Specific facial features of the subject
Any visible logos on clothing or background
postGenerationChecks: Check for clean intersections between geometric shapes.
Ensure the teal text is legible against the white background.
Verify the sepia tone is uniform across the photographic elements.
Confirm the diagonal lines do not obscure the subject's face.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a desaturated urban portrait with high-contrast white geometric overlays and condensed italicized sans-serif type for a modern, masculine editorial look.
